_comment: Adult panel sources. URLs are shown as plain text during play.

label.zhHant: ASPCA — 對狗貓有害的食物
label.en: ASPCA — Foods that are hazardous to dogs and cats

note.zhHant: 關於可能傷害寵物的食物的一般安全參考。草稿內容尚未經獸醫審核。
note.en: General safety reference for foods that can harm pets. Draft content has not been reviewed by a veterinarian.

label.zhHant: FDA — 對寵物不好的食物
label.en: FDA — Foods that are bad for pets

note.zhHant: 公開消費者指引。把食物給寵物前，一定要先問大人。
note.en: Public consumer guidance. Always ask a grown-up before offering any food to a pet.

note.zhHant: 精選的消費前剩餘食物（廚房或市場尚未使用、仍安全的食物）和盤中剩菜或腐壞食物不同。本遊戲只教檢查習慣——從不教餵食份量或食譜。
note.en: Selected pre-consumer surplus (unused, still-safe food from kitchens or markets) is not the same as plate scraps or spoiled food. This game teaches inspection habits only — never feeding amounts or recipes.
